mapper.select: SELECT p.post_id AS postId, p.board_id AS boardId, b.read_scope AS readScope, p.created_at AS createdAt, p.view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_likes pl WHERE pl.post_id = p.post_id) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.post_id AND c.state = 'normal' AND c.is_private = 0) AS commentCount FROM posts p JOIN boards b ON b.board_id = p.board_id WHERE p.state = 'normal' AND b.state = 'normal' AND b.trending_enabled = 1 AND p.created_at >= DATE_SUB(#{until}, INTERVAL #{maxAgeHours} HOUR) AND p.created_at < #{until}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO stats_post_hourly (stat_hour, post_id, board_id, read_scope, view_count, like_count, comment_count, view_delta, like_delta, comment_delta, raw_score, baseline_score, spike_ratio, freshness, final_score, rank_no, is_trending) VALUES
(#{r.statHour}, #{r.postId}, #{r.boardId}, #{r.readScope}, #{r.viewCount}, #{r.likeCount}, #{r.commentCount}, #{r.viewDelta}, #{r.likeDelta}, #{r.commentDelta}, #{r.rawScore}, #{r.baselineScore}, #{r.spikeRatio}, #{r.freshness}, #{r.finalScore}, #{r.rankNo}, #{r.isTrending})
AS new ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE board_id = new.board_id, read_scope = new.read_scope, view_count = new.view_count, like_count = new.like_count, comment_count = new.comment_count, view_delta = new.view_delta, like_delta = new.like_delta, comment_delta = new.comment_delta, raw_score = new.raw_score, baseline_score = new.baseline_score, spike_ratio = new.spike_ratio, freshness = new.freshness, final_score = new.final_score, rank_no = new.rank_no, is_trending = new.is_trending
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM stats_post_hourly WHERE stat_hour < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY)
